title: Reads the single Evia figures QR
details: Milos can now read Evia's single shared figures QR directly
The imported Evia record supplies the course, Learning Hours and evidence count already used by Milos
Milos also preserves Evia's course progress, attendance, target counts and EPA figures in the learner snapshot for assessor use
No learner name, contact details, evidence files or evidence text are imported from the Evia QR
The existing camera/media recording stack and observation workflow are unchanged
